about_the_game:
"Three Days After the Murderer" is a pixel style role-playing story game, players will play the protagonist Sun Shuling and his beloved cat Sun Ping 'an in the game, stripping the silk and pulling the cocoon to find the whereabouts of the murderer who killed the teacher, and bring him to justice, to realize the last wish of life.

【 About the story 】

The murderer who has been on the run for more than 20 years after killing a master family is in sight, but the thirty-nine-year-old working woman Sun Shuling died unexpectedly at this time!

"Please give me a little more time to bring the murderer to justice!"

Begging for permission from the earth's emissaries, Sun Shuling's ghost can continue to stay in the world for 72 hours, she must in this last limited time, at all costs to catch the vicious murderer.

【 About the protagonist 】

(Photo) Sun Shuling

The player's object of control.

The first protagonist of this play, thirty-nine years old, successful career women, in a medium-sized enterprise as a department head.

Childhood living conditions are not good, parents died in the second day of the second year, boarding in the grandparents home, the family is poor. Fortunately got the teacher in charge of the teacher Wen's help, this kindness has been continued until high school graduation, but after entering the university, the teacher's family was killed, the murderer is unknown, from then on with a heavy hate life.

One day when eating in the restaurant downstairs in the company, accidentally saw the face of the murderer in the mobile phone video interface of the woman at the next table, and suffered an unexpected situation accidentally died in the excitement, after getting the permission of the ghost messenger pool wind, began to track the whereabouts of the murderer.

(Photo) Sun Ping 'an

The player's object of control.

The female cat, in her early four years old, was originally a stray cat and was adopted by Sun Shuling when she was about half a year old.

Character is high cold and proud, but love their own master, can see the ghost of Sun Shuling, so stick to her to act with her, and therefore become the biggest help of Sun Shuling on the road to chase the murderer, for her to complete the ghost can not do all kinds of things. (But how much more can a kitten do than a ghost?)

【 About the gameplay 】

1. Role switching

Players can switch back and forth between the two characters of Sun Shuling and Cat, and different characters can achieve different gameplay, interact with different environments, and obtain different information.

2. Collect clues

When playing as the protagonist, the player can manipulate the protagonist to wander around the scene, peeping at other people's screens or eavesdropping on other people's conversations in order to achieve the collection of clues.

When playing as a cat, players can manipulate the cat to explore various corners of the scene, and find new items in their own pet satchel.

3. Avoid jumps

Ghosts can only be seen by animals, not humans, so the protagonist can go to any scene at will, unlike cats.

Therefore, when playing as a cat, if you need to break into a certain "forbidden area", the player needs to manipulate the cat to jump or dodge, or use props to attack the keeper to achieve the purpose.

4. Dialog options

As a story game, this game has a lot of text built in, and when talking to different characters, there may be multiple options for the player to choose from, different choices may go in different directions, or obtain different achievements.

Sometimes, the main character as a ghost will use the main character's special ability to enter other people's dreams, to find out the whereabouts of the murderer. When talking to the dream owner, the player must constantly choose the right options to increase the dream owner's trust in the protagonist, so as to obtain accurate clues.

5. Casual games

Dream owners have very different personalities, in addition to dialogue, they may also issue some tasks to the player, only to meet their requirements, they will reveal the whereabouts of the killer to the player!

For example, players may need to help dream master A win a card game, help dream Master B identify different patterns of nail art, and dream master C to have a real "battle"...

short_description: Play the ghost of the protagonist Sun Shuling and, within the last 72 hours of your "life", keep getting closer to the murderer's hideout by entering dreams, eavesdropping, peeping, and guiding your beloved cat to collect clues.
